Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.

Team player and detail oriented.
Previous experience with computer applications and software related to engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD).

Research, design, develop, manufacture, and test tools, engines, machines and other mechanical devices.
Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects.
Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.

Own the research, design, development, manufacturing, and testing of tools, engines, machines and other mechanical devices.
Lead analysis of customer design proposals, specifications, and manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects.
Direct drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.
cond_0152.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering
0-2 Years experience
Preferred Requirements
Creativity, verbal and written communication skills, analytical and problem solving ability
Team player and detail oriented
Ability to make sketches, engineering drawings and common computations
Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawing, schematics and computer-generated reports
Previous experience with computer applications and software related to engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD)

Research, design, develop, manufacture, and test tools, engines, machines and other mechanical devices.
Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects.
Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.

Bachelor's degree in engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in making sketches, engineering drawings, and common computations.
Strong command of reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Deep knowledge of computer applications and software related to the engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD).
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a detail-oriented approach.
Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Creativity in approaching engineering challenges.
